changeSet.author: Sebastian Abraham
changeSet.sql:
IF (EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'CacheStatus')) BEGIN drop table [dbo].CacheStatus END
IF (EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'utility' AND TABLE_NAME = 'JobActivity-retired')) BEGIN drop table [utility].[JobActivity-retired] END
changeSet.rollback:
IF (not EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'CacheStatus')) BEGIN
CREATE TABLE [dbo].[CacheStatus]( [Name] [varchar](250) NULL, [ShouldReCache] [bit] NULL ) ON [PRIMARY]
END
